parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ops.sync_cursors
(
    source_code,
    status,

    active_execution_id,
    lock_acquired_at,
    lock_expires_at,

    error_message,
    metadata,

    created_at,
    updated_at
)

VALUES
(
    $1::TEXT,
    'idle',

    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,

    NULL,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow_code',
        'WF-012',

        'calculation_version',
        1,

        'initialized_at',
        NOW()
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT
(
    source_code
)

DO UPDATE

SET
    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            ops.sync_cursors.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        ||
        jsonb_build_object(
            'workflow_code',
            'WF-012',

            'calculation_version',
            1,

            'last_initialized_at',
            NOW()
        ),

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    source_code,
    status,
    active_execution_id,
    lock_acquired_at,
    lock_expires_at,
    metadata,
    updated_at;

WITH recovered_cursor AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'error',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            'Bloqueo vencido recuperado automáticamente por WF-012.',

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    cursor.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                - 'active_workflow'
                - 'active_execution_id'
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'stale_lock_recovered',
                TRUE,

                'stale_lock_recovered_at',
                NOW(),

                'stale_lock_recovered_by',
                'WF-012'
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND cursor.active_execution_id
          IS NOT NULL

      AND (
          cursor.lock_expires_at <
              NOW()

          OR

          (
              cursor.lock_expires_at
                  IS NULL

              AND cursor.lock_acquired_at <
                  NOW()
                  -
                  make_interval(
                      mins =>
                          $2::INTEGER
                  )
          )
      )

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code
)

SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM recovered_cursor
    )
        AS stale_lock_recovered,

    cursor.source_code,
    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,
    cursor.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor.lock_expires_at,
    cursor.error_message,
    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT

LIMIT 1;

WITH acquired_cursor AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'running',

        active_execution_id =
            $2::TEXT,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NOW(),

        lock_expires_at =
            NOW()
            +
            make_interval(
                mins =>
                    $3::INTEGER
            ),

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                cursor.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'active_workflow',
                'WF-012',

                'active_execution_id',
                $2::TEXT,

                'active_execution_started_at',
                NOW(),

                'calculation_version',
                1
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND (
          cursor.active_execution_id
              IS NULL

          OR

          cursor.lock_expires_at <
              NOW()
      )

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at
)

SELECT
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM acquired_cursor
    )
        AS lock_acquired,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT acquired.status
            FROM acquired_cursor
                AS acquired
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        cursor.status
    )
        AS cursor_status,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT acquired.active_execution_id
            FROM acquired_cursor
                AS acquired
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        cursor.active_execution_id
    )
        AS active_execution_id,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT acquired.lock_acquired_at
            FROM acquired_cursor
                AS acquired
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        cursor.lock_acquired_at
    )
        AS lock_acquired_at,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT acquired.lock_expires_at
            FROM acquired_cursor
                AS acquired
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        cursor.lock_expires_at
    )
        AS lock_expires_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT

LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO ops.workflow_runs
(
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,

    status,
    started_at,

    completion_reason,

    metadata,

    created_at,
    updated_at
)

VALUES
(
    $1::TEXT,
    $2::TEXT,
    $3::TEXT,
    $4::TEXT,

    'running',
    NOW(),

    NULL,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'processing_mode',
        $5::TEXT,

        'max_documents',
        $6::INTEGER,

        'calculation_version',
        1,

        'started_by',
        'WF-012'
    ),

    NOW(),
    NOW()
)

ON CONFLICT
(
    n8n_execution_id
)

DO UPDATE

SET
    workflow_code =
        EXCLUDED.workflow_code,

    source_code =
        EXCLUDED.source_code,

    trigger_type =
        EXCLUDED.trigger_type,

    status =
        'running',

    started_at =
        NOW(),

    finished_at =
        NULL,

    completion_reason =
        NULL,

    error_node =
        NULL,

    error_message =
        NULL,

    error_details =
        NULL,

    metadata =
        COALESCE(
            ops.workflow_runs.metadata,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )
        ||
        EXCLUDED.metadata,

    updated_at =
        NOW()

RETURNING
    id,
    workflow_code,
    source_code,
    n8n_execution_id,
    trigger_type,
    status,
    started_at,
    metadata;

parameters.query:
WITH document_evaluation AS (
    SELECT
        document.id
            AS document_id,

        document.organization_id,
        document.capability_profile_id,

        document.document_type,
        document.document_name,
        document.document_status,

        document.issue_date,
        document.policy_validity_days,
        document.alert_days_before,

        document.renewal_due_date
            AS stored_renewal_due_date,

        document.expiration_date
            AS stored_expiration_date,

        document.alert_due_date
            AS stored_alert_due_date,

        document.renewal_status
            AS stored_renewal_status,

        (
            document.issue_date
            +
            document.policy_validity_days
        )::DATE
            AS expected_renewal_due_date,

        (
            document.issue_date
            +
            document.policy_validity_days
            + 1
        )::DATE
            AS expected_expiration_date,

        (
            document.issue_date
            +
            document.policy_validity_days
            -
            GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    document.alert_days_before,
                    0
                ),
                0
            )
        )::DATE
            AS expected_alert_due_date,

        CASE
            WHEN CURRENT_DATE >=
                 (
                     document.issue_date
                     +
                     document.policy_validity_days
                     + 1
                 )::DATE

                THEN 'expired'

            WHEN CURRENT_DATE >=
                 (
                     document.issue_date
                     +
                     document.policy_validity_days
                     -
                     GREATEST(
                         COALESCE(
                             document.alert_days_before,
                             0
                         ),
                         0
                     )
                 )::DATE

                THEN 'expiring'

            ELSE 'current'
        END
            AS expected_renewal_status

    FROM saas.organization_documents
        AS document

    WHERE document.document_status IN (
        'uploaded',
        'active'
    )

      AND document.replaced_by_document_id
          IS NULL

      AND document.issue_date
          IS NOT NULL

      AND document.policy_validity_days
          IS NOT NULL

      AND document.policy_validity_days > 0
),

pending_documents AS (
    SELECT
        evaluation.*

    FROM document_evaluation
        AS evaluation

    WHERE evaluation.stored_renewal_due_date
          IS DISTINCT FROM
          evaluation.expected_renewal_due_date

       OR evaluation.stored_expiration_date
          IS DISTINCT FROM
          evaluation.expected_expiration_date

       OR evaluation.stored_alert_due_date
          IS DISTINCT FROM
          evaluation.expected_alert_due_date

       OR evaluation.stored_renewal_status
          IS DISTINCT FROM
          evaluation.expected_renewal_status

    ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN evaluation.expected_renewal_status =
                 'expired'
                THEN 1

            WHEN evaluation.expected_renewal_status =
                 'expiring'
                THEN 2

            ELSE 3
        END,

        evaluation.expected_renewal_due_date ASC,

        evaluation.document_id ASC

    LIMIT $1::INTEGER
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS has_document,

    'pending_recalculation'
        AS claim_reason,

    pending.document_id,
    pending.organization_id,
    pending.capability_profile_id,

    pending.document_type,
    pending.document_name,
    pending.document_status,

    pending.issue_date,
    pending.policy_validity_days,
    pending.alert_days_before,

    pending.stored_renewal_due_date,
    pending.expected_renewal_due_date,

    pending.stored_expiration_date,
    pending.expected_expiration_date,

    pending.stored_alert_due_date,
    pending.expected_alert_due_date,

    pending.stored_renewal_status,
    pending.expected_renewal_status

FROM pending_documents
    AS pending

UNION ALL

SELECT
    FALSE,
    'no_documents',

    NULL::UUID,
    NULL::UUID,
    NULL::UUID,

    NULL::TEXT,
    NULL::TEXT,
    NULL::TEXT,

    NULL::DATE,
    NULL::INTEGER,
    NULL::INTEGER,

    NULL::DATE,
    NULL::DATE,

    NULL::DATE,
    NULL::DATE,

    NULL::DATE,
    NULL::DATE,

    NULL::TEXT,
    NULL::TEXT

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pending_documents
);

parameters.query:
WITH parameters AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $1::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )::UUID
            AS document_id,

        NULLIF(
            BTRIM(
                $2::TEXT
            ),
            ''
        )
            AS n8n_execution_id
),

valid_parameters AS (
    SELECT
        parameters.document_id,
        parameters.n8n_execution_id

    FROM parameters

    WHERE parameters.document_id
          IS NOT NULL
),

calculated_document AS (
    SELECT
        result.*

    FROM valid_parameters
        AS parameters

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL
        saas.recalculate_organization_document_validity_v1
        (
            parameters.document_id,
            parameters.n8n_execution_id,
            TRUE
        )
        AS result
)

SELECT
    calculated.document_id,
    calculated.organization_id,
    calculated.document_type,

    calculated.calculation_status,
    calculated.changed,
    calculated.changes_applied,

    calculated.previous_renewal_due_date,
    calculated.calculated_renewal_due_date,

    calculated.previous_expiration_date,
    calculated.calculated_expiration_date,

    calculated.previous_alert_due_date,
    calculated.calculated_alert_due_date,

    calculated.previous_renewal_status,
    calculated.calculated_renewal_status,

    calculated.validity_history_id

FROM calculated_document
    AS calculated

UNION ALL

SELECT
    NULL::UUID
        AS document_id,

    NULL::UUID
        AS organization_id,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS document_type,

    'skipped_no_document'::TEXT
        AS calculation_status,

    FALSE::BOOLEAN
        AS changed,

    FALSE::BOOLEAN
        AS changes_applied,

    NULL::DATE
        AS previous_renewal_due_date,

    NULL::DATE
        AS calculated_renewal_due_date,

    NULL::DATE
        AS previous_expiration_date,

    NULL::DATE
        AS calculated_expiration_date,

    NULL::DATE
        AS previous_alert_due_date,

    NULL::DATE
        AS calculated_alert_due_date,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS previous_renewal_status,

    NULL::TEXT
        AS calculated_renewal_status,

    NULL::UUID
        AS validity_history_id

FROM parameters

WHERE parameters.document_id
      IS NULL;

WITH execution_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER
            AS evaluated_documents,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE history.calculation_status =
                  'updated'
        )::INTEGER
            AS updated_documents,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE history.calculation_status =
                  'unchanged'
        )::INTEGER
            AS unchanged_documents,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE history.calculation_status =
                  'skipped'
        )::INTEGER
            AS skipped_documents,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE history.calculation_status =
                  'failed'
        )::INTEGER
            AS failed_documents

    FROM saas.organization_document_validity_history
        AS history

    WHERE history.workflow_code =
          'WF-012'

      AND history.n8n_execution_id =
          $1::TEXT
),

closed_run AS (
    UPDATE ops.workflow_runs
        AS run

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        finished_at =
            NOW(),

        completion_reason =
            CASE
                WHEN metrics.evaluated_documents = 0
                    THEN 'no_documents'

                ELSE 'completed'
            END,

        batches_processed =
            CASE
                WHEN metrics.evaluated_documents > 0
                    THEN 1

                ELSE 0
            END,

        records_read =
            metrics.evaluated_documents,

        records_written =
            metrics.updated_documents,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                run.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'evaluated_documents',
                metrics.evaluated_documents,

                'updated_documents',
                metrics.updated_documents,

                'unchanged_documents',
                metrics.unchanged_documents,

                'skipped_documents',
                metrics.skipped_documents,

                'failed_documents',
                metrics.failed_documents,

                'finished_by',
                'WF-012',

                'finished_at',
                NOW()
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    FROM execution_metrics
        AS metrics

    WHERE run.workflow_code =
          'WF-012'

      AND run.n8n_execution_id =
          $1::TEXT

    RETURNING
        run.id,
        run.status,
        run.completion_reason,
        run.finished_at,
        run.records_read,
        run.records_written
)

SELECT
    metrics.evaluated_documents,
    metrics.updated_documents,
    metrics.unchanged_documents,
    metrics.skipped_documents,
    metrics.failed_documents,

    run.id
        AS workflow_run_id,

    run.status
        AS workflow_run_status,

    run.completion_reason,
    run.finished_at,

    TRUE
        AS execution_finalized

FROM execution_metrics
    AS metrics

LEFT JOIN closed_run
    AS run

    ON TRUE;

WITH released_cursor AS (
    UPDATE ops.sync_cursors
        AS cursor

    SET
        status =
            'success',

        active_execution_id =
            NULL,

        lock_acquired_at =
            NULL,

        lock_expires_at =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(
                    cursor.metadata,
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
                - 'active_workflow'
                - 'active_execution_id'
                - 'active_execution_started_at'
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'last_successful_workflow',
                'WF-012',

                'last_successful_execution_id',
                $2::TEXT,

                'last_successful_finished_at',
                NOW(),

                'lock_released',
                TRUE
            ),

        updated_at =
            NOW()

    WHERE cursor.source_code =
          $1::TEXT

      AND cursor.active_execution_id::TEXT =
          $2::TEXT

    RETURNING
        cursor.source_code,
        cursor.status,
        cursor.active_execution_id,
        cursor.lock_acquired_at,
        cursor.lock_expires_at,
        cursor.error_message,
        cursor.updated_at
)

SELECT
    TRUE
        AS lock_released,

    released.source_code,

    released.status
        AS cursor_status,

    released.active_execution_id,
    released.lock_acquired_at,
    released.lock_expires_at,
    released.error_message,
    released.updated_at

FROM released_cursor
    AS released

UNION ALL

SELECT
    FALSE
        AS lock_released,

    cursor.source_code,

    cursor.status
        AS cursor_status,

    cursor.active_execution_id,
    cursor.lock_acquired_at,
    cursor.lock_expires_at,
    cursor.error_message,
    cursor.updated_at

FROM ops.sync_cursors
    AS cursor

WHERE cursor.source_code =
      $1::TEXT

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM released_cursor
  )

LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode:
const lockResult =
  $input.first()?.json ?? {};

const configuration =
  $("Configurar procesamiento WF-012")
    .first()
    .json;

return [
  {
    json: {
      workflow_code:
        configuration.workflow_code,

      source_code:
        configuration.source_code,

      execution_status:
        'omitted',

      completion_reason:
        'lock_not_acquired',

      execution_omitted:
        true,

      attempted_execution_id:
        String(
          $execution.id ?? ''
        ),

      active_execution_id:
        lockResult.active_execution_id
        ?? null,

      cursor_status:
        lockResult.cursor_status
        ?? null,

      lock_acquired_at:
        lockResult.lock_acquired_at
        ?? null,

      lock_expires_at:
        lockResult.lock_expires_at
        ?? null,

      message:
        'WF-012 no se ejecutó porque otra ejecución conserva un bloqueo activo.',

      finished_at:
        new Date().toISOString(),
    },
  },
];;
